description: Système de routes (v 1998) des routes régionales flamandes is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Katholieke Universiteit Leuven. The route system includes the Flemish Regional Roads (including motorway entrances and exits). The system is built in Arc/Info based on the theme streets from the skeleton file streetnet97 of TeleAtlas. Coverage: Katholieke Universiteit Leuven. The portal shows the English title as "Route system (v 1998) of the Flemish Regional Roads" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Katholieke Universiteit Leuven. Its keywords include WEGTYPE, Route93, MVG - DEPARTEMENT LIN - AWV, WEGNAAM, VERKEER, AWV. The listing shows 1998-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
